title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- NO DECEPTION

content.rendered: “And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,” (Luke 8: 43)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The woman with the issue of blood came in contact with physicians. She met the right people considering the fact that she had a health challenge; but she spent all she had on them, and her problem remained. They would have posed as people who had solutions to her problems, but in the end, they didn’t have solutions. They posed like helpers, but all they did was to drain her of all her resources.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: every man that is posing as a helper but is positioned to reduce your destiny, I command them to be removed from your life. Every man who has come to reduce your destiny to rubbles but is currently posing like a supporter, I command them to be exposed and removed from your life; every idea that is posing like a major breakthrough but is plotting to impoverish you, may they be exposed.The woman with the issue of blood kept moving from doctor to doctor, spending whatever she could, yet her results remained the same. She continued trusting the people she met, but they kept disappointing her again and again. Every man who is posing as a helper but plotting to deceive you and rob you of hard earned resources, I command the fire of God to take them away from your life.God will open your eyes so that you do not go down by the devices of the crafty. Your eyes and ears will be open to the leading of the Spirit of God, so that you don’t end up a victim of those who are seeking a chance to rip you off. God will grant you the spirit of discernment, so that you can discern between true helpers and scammers; God will help you see through the antics of those whose plot is take advantage of you.The season of being deceived by reducers posing as helpers, is over. Henceforth, you will not be deceived. No man shall take advantage of you.Isaiah 30: 21 says: “And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.”Declare With Me: I won’t be deceived; my helpers will not turn against me, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
